data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and step order (open form, enter origin, enter destination, pick dates, click Find flights) and covers the main parameters. It adds trip-type, traveler and cabin steps the observed occurrence didn't use, and it omits the "Book with miles" toggle, so it's slightly off. It is concrete enough to automate, but it doesn't say how the dates are picked or how the suggestion is chosen.
